correctness.rationale: The exact fixed-q inclusion–exclusion tail identity cancels one- and two-point avoidance probabilities across line and full q-block draws. Noncollinear triple avoidance a*=(q−2)/(q+1) strictly exceeds all other uncancelled avoidance bases; its multiplicity is q^3(q−1)^2(q+1)/6. Exactly q draws cover the plane by a parallel class, more often than q uniform full subsets. For q=3 the 511-subset coefficient algebra plus a monotone exponential-polynomial comparison proves the unique sign crossover after t=3. I independently constructed AG(2,3) as twelve lines, ran exact rational union-state DP for both models t=1..12, verified Δ(3)=−13/1176, Δ(4)=1/336, positivity t=4..12, and 72 noncollinear triples. General orders are proved analytically, not by finite test.
